title: Labor Market Outcomes of Restatements for Corporate Accountants
eligible_reason: Every regression in Replicate Code.do includes time-varying firm or employee controls (ceo_period cfo_period size roa sale_growth female_ratio avg_age, or age tenure etc.), which the protocol excludes. The two designs are (i) a within-firm triple difference comparing accountants with HR employees before vs. after a restatement announcement (post, acc, post_acc with firm and fiscal-year FE), which also includes the extra 'post' regressor, and (ii) a DiD against matched non-restatement firms (post, treat_post) with the same controls. Table 11 adds entropy-balancing weights (_webal) and relative-year dummies. No data are shipped.
design_notes: Firm-period panel (two periods per firm: pre- and post-restatement, 'period' 1/3) of 201 restatement firms 2004-2014 (Table 3: N = 725 firm-function-periods, 201 cik clusters, 19 fyear clusters) and 320 firms incl. matched controls (Table 5B: N = 640, 320 gvkey clusters). FE: cik (or gvkey) + fyear; cluster cik fyear. Table 3: reghdfe left_ratio post acc post_acc $controls; Table 5B: reghdfe left_ratio post treat_post $controls (treat_post = restatement firm x post); Tables 4/5C/7/10B: employee-level promotion / next-job outcomes with employee controls; Table 11: employee-year left_d with acc x relative-year dummies (acc_pre_1 acc_post_0 ... post_2), controls, [pw=_webal], window announce_year +/- 2; Table 12: CEM-matched sample and ffi12#fyear FE. Treatment timing is staggered (restatements 2004-2014), but no column is free of time-varying controls.
never_treated_note: Matched non-restatement firms (treat = 0) in Tables 5B/6B; HR employees within restatement firms are the within-firm comparison group elsewhere.

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls (ceo_period cfo_period size roa sale_growth female_ratio avg_age); within-firm triple difference with extra post and acc regressors

specs.controls: post acc ceo_period cfo_period size roa sale_growth female_ratio avg_age
specs.sample_condition: 201 restatement firms, pre and post periods

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls; 'post' main effect for matched control firms
specs.treatment_definition: treat (restatement firm) x post (after the matched restatement announcement)
specs.controls: post ceo_period cfo_period size roa sale_growth female_ratio avg_age
specs.sample_condition: restatement firms plus matched non-restatement firms (N = 640, 320 firms)
specs.notes: nearest miss: dropping controls and 'post' would give a staggered TWFE DiD with matched controls

specs.exclusion_reason: employee-level outcomes with time-varying employee and firm controls; post/acc main effects
specs.controls: ceo_period cfo_period size roa age tenure female highest_degree cpa mba (+ post acc)

specs.exclusion_reason: entropy-balancing weights (_webal), relative-year dummies for all employees, time-varying controls

specs.controls: pre_1 post_0 post_1 post_2 roa size ceo_period cfo_period age tenure female highest_degree cpa mba
